scenario.title: Correct, retry, waive or replace QA
situations: A test failed because its definition was wrong.
A required case cannot be performed.
A retry or plan edit leaves the item blocked.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Recovery reference reviewed; authorization and edge-case mutation semantics require targeted implementation validation, not this map.
Command nodes, when present, were checked with installed CLI --help only; this proves parser/help availability, not serving-control-plane capability or successful execution.

lessons.title: Choose the honest recovery
lessons.when: When QA fails, its definition is wrong, a case cannot be performed, or a current gate remains unsatisfied.
lessons.need: Retry collects new evidence; correction changes the definition through supported currency rules; waiver records a justified exception; supersession requires a replacement obligation. None rewrites a failure as a pass.
lessons.surface: Named QA refusals; requirement state and correction reference
lessons.gap: Recovery depth exists but is scattered. Review question: should JOURNEYS add failed-or-stale-QA as a situation with a short agent diagnosis and one exact next step?

lessons.title: Settle before terminal closeout
lessons.when: Before closing an item or release while an execution, verdict or review may remain unsettled.
lessons.need: An active, verdict-less or pending-review QA execution can still block closing work. Preserve the owning subject and resume/abort/settle through its registered surface.
lessons.surface: QA settlement gate documentation; existing finalization/recovery
lessons.gap: Review question: should completion output distinguish passed, waived/discharged, no-obligation and still-unanswered checks instead of a single done claim?
